operation: First exact original-token sample from the frozen full-V product conditioned on strict UTF8 JSON. Batch32 of the SAME frozen product is a separate secondary operation. No marginals required from any method.
budget_reason: Candidates have a pre-sampling certified proposal-exhaustion probability<=1e-9. Controls get MORE proposals to avoid winning by an artificially small control ceiling. Equal120s/3GiB physics for every method; resource refusals additional to the mathematical proposal bound.
primary: Paired median total first-sample wall AND CPU <=0.8 against EVERY mandatory comparator and favorable sign in EVERY completed paired repetition, or localized FIRST-operation capacity gain under equal internal budgets. Every candidate repetition must complete. No capacity credit for only a batch refusal or external supervisor failure.
selection: ONE candidate by strong first-sample wins on ALL18 development states only; tie handoff. Zero wins rejects speed adoption. Secondary batch-only gain is separately labeled and cannot be relabeled a first-sample victory.
secondary: Same strict paired rule for all32 cached samples, includes initial preparation and SAME model forward once. Validate all originals/bytes. Report first and full-batch refusals separately; no censoring-based distribution claim.
cost: Primary service query includes actual archived forward+full softmax, rational conversion, ALL attempted depths/fallback, envelope/counter/CARS preparation, original-ID reconstruction and strict JSON validation. Report decoder-table/normalizer cold preparation too. Common model loading/warmup recorded separately; decoder-cold is NOT whole model/server cold startup. Raw rejection is not charged a lexer table. Exact controls compute ONLY their sample, not outside/marginals.
correctness: All conclusive exact full masses must agree; every envelope has L<=Z<=M and reject probability1-Z/M<=delta whenever ground truth exists. ALL words independently pass original fixed IDs and strict UTF8/Python JSON; aliases and unsupported special bytes preserved. Tiny actual RNG-law oracles run offline before timing.
development: All18 archived A22 states, no new model forwards and no outcome filtering. A24 timings are a DIFFERENT operation and are not evidence of an A25 victory.
independent: All five pre-pinned JSONTestSuite documents/all4,8,16 masks after development-only selection. Original sampler was frozen in25/v1 BEFORE A24 head captures. v2 statically skips uncertifiable zero-lower intermediate tails (empty-lower-addendum), AFTER those shared captures but BEFORE ANY A25 measurement; accepted laws unchanged. Their full-V heads are reused openly, NOT new A25 forwards or unseen by A24/v2. No candidate changes based on A24 external outcomes; stronger CARS controls/finite-budget interpretation are also frozen before A25 timing.
trajectory: Separately freeze a real MDLM loop/common commitment policy. With fixedk proposal budgets, conditional accepted kernels exact but FAIL gives global TV<=sum epsilon_t^k, assuming all preparations/recognizers conclude. NOT exact native conditioned MDLM path (Twister).
claims: Original-token/rational law and delimited mathematical comparison. NOT a new generic rejection principle or OS* framework, not native CARS/EPIC/FactorDLM or semantic/training superiority, no human review/publication or universal priority.
